mathematical_evidence: P1 Postulate (i) requires a nonzero state space; its (iii) requires trace-one preparations. The species-sector definition (d) already states that a zero sector admits no trace-one preparation.

For the counterexample d=1,N=2, the sole exchange unitary is I, hence P_-=(I-I)/2=0. The zero-space operator is self-adjoint mathematically, but cannot acquire the stated physical assignment under P1.

For the exchange counterexample, normalized C_c^infinity orbitals on disjoint balls belong to H2, are orthonormal and have conjugate(u)v=0. The absolute Coulomb exchange integral is zero. The supplied theorem proves pair energies D+-X and X>=0, which imply the exact amended equality/strictness alternatives.
